sup:70610.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor [n25527] (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding bundle the fastener kit with one distributor.
Our latest forecast for part:360010 grows +6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Today you supply 40 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 24-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 30,000 complete bundles of part:360010, part:360011, part:360012, part:360030 per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the verified volume increase, which allows us to improve our offer.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.57 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We gladly accept your proposal for 14-day payment terms to support a more competitive price. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €5.48 per unit, with a contract term of 24 months.

Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, our colleagues will provide further context on our pricing structure as a distributor. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued interest in our range and services. We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract, which provides planning certainty and allows us to adjust our offer. 

Please note that we have already taken that volume change data into account. While we note the forecast increase for part:360011, we have already factored volume growth into our previous pricing. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary offer stands at a price of €5.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. As an alternative, in exchange for 60-day payment terms and a 36-month contract, we can offer a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
